text:
Situation: Ephedrine sulfate 5 mg/mL 10 mL vials are low at Corvale East (6.6 days, 33 vials) while Corvale General holds 18.6 days (111 vials). The product used at both sites is labeled by Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083061010) and manufactured at Gland Pharma Limited, FEI 3002647489, India.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include ephedrine sulfate as of 2026-10-21. FDA's most recent inspection of the Gland Pharma plant ended 2024-07-25 and was classified VAI. Alternate manufacturers and their plants' most recent FDA inspections: Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (Fresenius Kabi Austria, VAI 2024-03-21); NorthStar RxLLC (Maiva Pharma Private Limited, VAI 2022-10-29); Sandoz Inc (SANDOZ); Xiromed, LLC (Maiva Pharma Private Limited, VAI 2022-10-29).

Our position: No national shortage is declared. The imbalance is site-specific. Internal transfer can equalize supply quickly. Alternate sources are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 27 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — leaves sender with 14 days and receiver with 12 days. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Place purchase orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC to replenish both sites. Approval: buyer.
3. Place purchase orders with NorthStar RxLLC as secondary source. Approval: buyer.
4. Evaluate Sandoz Inc and Xiromed, LLC for additional supply agreements. Approval: buyer.

Not recommended: Delaying transfer while awaiting new purchases; allocating clinical alternatives without committee review.
